sources.title: We Need a Safe Place to Talk About How We Feel: A Randomized Controlled Trial of a Peer Grief Support Intervention for Youth in Foster Care
findings: Abstract reports positive six-month hope, social-support and self-worth outcomes.
limitations: Waitlist could join after eight weeks; six-month observations are not an untreated randomized comparison.
Institutional report conditions short-term treatment analyses on attending at least one session.
Attrition, attendance selection, expectancy and changing placements limit causal interpretation.

sources.title: The L.Y.G.H.T. Program: An Evaluation of a Peer Grief Support Intervention for Youth in Foster Care
sources.authors_short: Mitchell, Schuurman, Shapiro, Sattler, Sorensen and Martinez
sources.design: Randomized waitlist mixed-method study; six-week assessments
sources.population: Youth in three foster-care group homes
findings: Publisher abstract reports improved social support, hopefulness and self-worth; total problem behaviours remained unchanged.
limitations: Small selected setting; controlled estimates and their uncertainty not extracted from full text.
Shared programme authors do not establish independent replication.

sources.title: A prospective observational study of lucid episodes in advanced dementia
sources.original_date_note: Exact first-online date not independently verified; issue citation is 8 September 2025.
sources.design: Prospective audiovisual observations; multi-informant validation; within-person baseline comparison
findings: Directly observed episodes included increased meaningful vocalizations; features varied between people.
limitations: Events cluster within three people: nine episodes are not nine independent participants.
Small observational cohort cannot establish population prevalence or a survival mechanism.
Full methods, confounder handling and neural measures not reviewed.
